name: uchiyomi
description: A self-hosted manga server that downloads too: it serves your manga, manhwa and webtoons like a library server and fetches new chapters like a source app, so discover, grab, monitor, serve and read all happen in one container. Point it at a folder of CBZ/CBR files and read them on any device through a true-black OLED interface built webtoon-first. Installs as a PWA, works offline. Mihon/Tachiyomi extensions, MangaDex, AniList/MyAnimeList/Kitsu sync, OPDS, per-user progress and favourites, age ratings, two-factor auth, single sign-on, nightly backups. No account and no cloud; the update check can be turned off and the anonymous install count is off unless you turn it on. The database runs inside the container; there is nothing else to install.

paths.name: Library
paths.description: Your existing CBZ/CBR library. Any folder layout works. Set PUID/PGID to the owner of these files for renames and deletes; otherwise it is read-only.

paths.name: Data (embedded database)
paths.description: Postgres lives here. Back it up like any appdata, or rely on the nightly dump in Backups.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Nightly database and config dumps. Ideally a different disk from Data.

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: The port you open in a browser.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Run as this user id (Unraid's nobody is 99). Use the owner of your library to allow renames and deletes.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Run as this group id (Unraid's users is 100).

variables.name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
variables.description: How you reach it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 or https://manga.example.com. Must match, or logins and cookies break.

variables.name: FLARESOLVERR_URL
variables.description: A FlareSolverr instance for Cloudflare-protected sources, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8191. Optional.

variables.name: SUWAYOMI_URL
variables.description: Optional: Mihon/Tachiyomi extensions. Install uchiyomi-suwayomi from Apps (the extension engine, set up the way Uchiyomi needs it), then put http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:4567 here. A Suwayomi you already run works too: set FLARESOLVERR_ENABLED=true and FLARESOLVERR_URL on it, or extension sources behind Cloudflare fail. Empty = no extensions; MangaDex and sites you add by address work without it.

variables.name: SUWAYOMI_USERNAME
variables.description: Only if the engine requires a password (its AUTH_MODE basic_auth): the same user name.

variables.name: UCHIYOMI_PLATFORM
variables.description: Tells Admin, Extensions which setup steps to show. Leave it.

variables.name: BACKUP_KEEP
variables.description: How many nightly backups to keep.
